Expanding Motion Curriculum (Coming Soon)

Save STEPMASTER to access an expanding lineup of motion-based content:

* K-POP Dance — rhythm, timing, and performance-focused choreography
* WT Advanced Poomsae — high-level World Taekwondo forms
* ITF Standard Pattern — foundational ITF patterns
* ITF Advanced Pattern — high-difficulty ITF patterns
* Modern & Traditional Dance — expressive movement, balance, and flow
* Designed as a long-term platform that grows in depth and diversity.

One Platform, Multiple Disciplines

Train across martial arts, dance, and movement disciplines in a single VR app.

Taekwondo & Taichi & Yoga (available now)

Structured forms, choreography, and expressive movement

Built for beginners, practitioners, and advanced performers alike

Expert Demonstrations & AI Feedback

Experience authentic human motion captured with professional-grade motion capture.

Precise joint and posture calibration

Demonstrations by certified instructors

Real-time AI feedback on posture, timing, rhythm, and accuracy

Performance scoring and progress tracking ( Taekwondo & Dance )

Built to Grow With You

STEPMASTER is not a one-time experience — it’s a platform designed to evolve.

Structured learning paths and interactive tutorials

Gamified, motivating VR training

Regular updates with new disciplines and advanced content

Meet your AI Motion Coach in STEPMASTER.
Save now to unlock more ways to train, move, and master motion as the platform grows.
